rca of the issue: Duplicate-key warning RCA: React console message names concrete IDs (dept_platform, dept_data, dept_crm, dept_sales, job_sfdc_lead_bangalore x16, job_sfdc_arch_austin x2). Root cause is a .map() over an array that contains the same entity twice (likely from a join/merge on the frontend such as merging teams-with-departments where the department row is emitted per team) using entity.id as the React key. Fix: either de-duplicate the source array before .map(), or use a composite key like `${dept.id}-${team.id}` where duplication is expected.
